name: Nimble Fingers (Achievement)
body:
Your ability to palm objects is quick, nimble, and practiced.

Prerequisite: Successfully use Sleight of Hand to lift objects from 50 different targets without their knowledge.

Benefit: When using Sleight of Hand as a move action, you suffer only a -5 penalty to the check.

Normal: When using Sleight of Hand as a move action, you suffer a -20 penalty to the check.
